summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K covering September 2026 treasury-share activity, reporting the company's only securities and derivatives operations for the month. The filing discloses a closing balance of 27 Class A preferred shares held in treasury, held in compliance with Article 11 of CVM Resolution 44/2021, with no intermediate trading operations, volumes or prices shown. CFO Carlos Augusto Machado Pereira de Almeida Brandão signed the report dated October 9, 2026. No special-situation event, transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is present; no risk-arb angle applies to this routine disclosure.
